calendar.title: Calendar subscriptions
calendar.description: Put your DiveDay departures on the calendar you already use. Subscribing is read-only: DiveDay never reads or changes anything in your calendar.
calendar.refreshNote: Your calendar decides how often it re-reads the feed — usually within a few hours, not instantly. Treat DiveDay as the source of truth for a same-day change.

assignments.name: My departures
assignments.detail: Every trip you are assigned to crew, teach, or captain.

shopTrips.name: All shop departures
shopTrips.detail: Every scheduled departure at this shop, whoever is crewing it.

status.neverRead: No calendar has read it yet — paste the link into one to finish.

actions.confirmRotate: Replace this link? Any calendar still using the old one stops updating.
actions.confirmTurnOff: Turn off this subscription? The link stops working immediately.

newLink.heading: Your subscription link
newLink.shownOnce: Copy this now — for your security it is shown once. If you lose it, replace the link to get a new one.
newLink.webcalHint: Opens your calendar app and subscribes.

warning.rotate: Replacing the link stops the old one working right away. Any calendar still using it will quietly stop updating until you paste the new link in.
warning.shared: Anyone with this link can read these departures without signing in. Treat it like a password.

notice.denied: You do not have access to that calendar scope.

calendar.coverage: Covers departures from {past} days ago through {future} days ahead.

staffing.title: Staffing
staffing.description: See who is working, what each person is qualified to teach or crew, and where the next boat still has a coverage gap.

working.heading: Who is working
working.managerOnly: Shift changes require owner or manager

addShift.heading: Add a working shift
addShift.detail: A shift says when someone is available. Assign the actual crew on each trip separately.

coverage.heading: Coverage gaps
coverage.detail: These are prompts to resolve before the manifest becomes a dock-side surprise.
coverage.noTrips: No scheduled trips in this window.
coverage.allGood: Crew is assigned, and their shift covers this trip.

gap.no_shift_coverage: No working shift covers this trip

notice.overlap: That person already has an overlapping shift.
notice.staffNotFound: That staff member is no longer on this shop's team.
notice.invalid: Check the shift date and times, then try again.
notice.notAuthorized: Only owners and managers can change shifts.

new.title: New order

notice.invalid: Pick a customer and at least one line item with an amount.
notice.notConnected: Connect a Stripe account in Shop settings before creating an order.
notice.stripeFailed: Stripe couldn't create that invoice. Try again in a moment.

new.courseNote: The course's instruction and e-learning lines are pre-filled from your catalog. One invoice, two lines: clear the e-learning line if this student already completed it elsewhere.
new.noPriceNote: This trip has no price set, so the trip fee below is blank — add one on the trip page to skip this step next time.
new.priceNote: The trip fee below is pre-filled from this trip's price.
new.notePlaceholder: e.g. Two-tank reef trip + rental set

detail.openInvoiceHint: — share this link with the customer if Stripe's email didn't reach them.
detail.demoActionHint: Demo orders aren't backed by a live Stripe invoice, so this action is disabled.

notice.refreshFailed: Couldn't reach Stripe to refresh this order.
notice.voidFailed: Couldn't void this order — it may already be paid or void.
notice.refunded: Payment refunded — the trip now shows as unpaid for this diver.
notice.refundFailed: Couldn't refund this order — it may not have a refundable payment yet.
notice.notAuthorized: Refunds are limited to owners and managers — ask one of them to issue this refund.
notice.demoDisabled: This is a demo order — it isn't backed by a live Stripe invoice, so it can't be changed.

promos.title: Discounts a diver can type
promos.description: A code works across your whole schedule, unlike the one-trip deal you send from a departure's page. DiveDay creates it on your own Stripe account, and Stripe enforces the expiry and the redemption cap when the diver pays.

notice.created: Code created and live on your Stripe account.
notice.disabled: Code switched off — it stops discounting immediately.
notice.invalid: Check the code, discount, and dates and try again.
notice.invalidCode: A code can use letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores only.
notice.invalidWindow: The end date has to come after the start date.
notice.duplicate: You already have a code with that text.
notice.notConnected: Connect your Stripe account in Settings first — a code is created on your own account.
notice.stripeFailed: Stripe didn't create that code. It's saved as failed here and can't discount anything; try again.
notice.notAuthorized: Promo codes discount real money, so they're limited to owners and managers.

promos.connectBanner: Connect your Stripe account in <settingsLink>Settings</settingsLink> before creating a code — the coupon lives on your account, not DiveDay's.

newCode.heading: New code
newCode.detail: Divers type this at checkout. Leave the dates or the cap empty for no limit.

fields.whatForHint: (optional — your note, never shown to divers)

empty.heading: No codes yet
empty.detail: Create one above, or send a one-trip deal from a departure's page when a boat needs filling.

reviews.title: What divers said
reviews.description: Every review here was left through a diver's own post-trip recap link, so all of them came from someone who was on the boat. A rating on its own publishes straight away; anything with words waits for you.

notice.published: Review published to your schedule page.
notice.hidden: Review hidden — it no longer counts toward your rating.
notice.error: That review couldn't be updated. Try again.

reviews.acrossCount: Across {count, plural, one {# published review} other {# published reviews}}
reviews.emptyDetail: Divers are asked for one on their recap page after a trip sails. The first ones will land here.
reviews.ratingOnly: Rating only — no words to review.
